capability.summary: Map one XML document to a simplified JSON element tree
capability.description: Parses one local XML file with lxml and returns a simplified recursive element tree containing each element's local tag name, raw attribute mapping, optional stripped direct text, and optional element children. It reports XMLSyntaxError as JSON but is not a lossless XML representation.
capability.problem_space: Simplified structural inspection of one well-formed XML document as JSON. It is not XML Schema/DTD validation, XPath querying, namespace-preserving or round-trip conversion, canonicalization, remote endpoint processing, or a general secure parser for untrusted XML.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string at CLI position 1 naming an existing XML file. Output: JSON envelope with a recursive json node shaped as {tag, attrib, optional text, optional children}; no output file is written.
accepted_inputs: an existing local, well-formed XML document parseable by lxml.etree.parse
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "lxml", target: string, json: {tag: string, attrib: object, text?: string, children?: [node, ...]}}, exit 0. Non-existing path: {status: "error", message: string}, exit 2. XMLSyntaxError: {status: "error", tool: "lxml", message: "invalid XML: <details>"}, exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. Other I/O, parser, QName, recursion, or serialization exceptions are uncaught and may produce a traceback/non-JSON exit.
limitations: reads and recursively materializes the complete XML tree and complete JSON result in memory; document depth, node count, and result size are unbounded and can amplify memory use
has no output truncation and no timeout; large or deeply nested documents can consume substantial memory or exhaust recursion
element namespace URIs/prefixes are discarded from tag names via QName.localname, while namespaced attribute keys may remain in lxml expanded-name form
drops comments, processing instructions, namespace declarations, child tail text, document metadata, and whitespace-only/direct surrounding text; it is not round-trip lossless
uses lxml's default parser without explicit entity, DTD, recovery, size, depth, or network-hardening options, so it should not be treated as a hardened untrusted-XML boundary
only XMLSyntaxError is converted to the documented error envelope; other failures can traceback, and deeply nested XML can exhaust recursion

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing a simplified recursive XML element tree (`tag`, `attrib`, optional `text` and `children`) or a handled parse error.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.
